learning_outcomes.text: Classify financial assets using the business model and cash-flow characteristics tests
Account for financial liabilities and the treatment of own credit risk
Apply the expected credit loss impairment model at a conceptual level
Explain initial and subsequent measurement for the main instrument categories
Describe the conditions and mechanics of hedge accounting
Account for derecognition and common reclassifications

integrative_case: A corporate treasury holds trade receivables, a portfolio of bonds held to collect and sell, a loan it may securitise, and a forward contract hedging foreign-currency purchases; classify and measure each instrument, apply the expected-credit-loss model to the receivables and loan, and decide whether hedge accounting and derecognition apply.
assesses: knowledge and applied reasoning on every in-scope outcome via MCQ/MR
case-based decisions in the integrative case
